decisionRules: Snapshot source bytes before hashing, parsing, mapping, or repository work.

failureModes: A delivery identity can arrive with changed source meaning after its receipt is recorded.
A logical acquisition can arrive through another delivery with changed byte or semantic meaning.
Malformed or scientifically unsupported content can reach the instrument boundary.
Parser, mapper, or candidate publication work can stop before the accepted state changes.
A content-digest implementation can report one digest for distinct captured bytes.
recoveryMoves: Return changed fields and both fingerprints for transport-level review while preserving the recorded delivery.
Retain the incoming raw capture and typed conflict quarantine while preserving the established acquisition.
Preserve exact bytes with a stable reason, bounded details, and constructive mapping or source-repair route.
Discard the candidate maps and retry from the same immutable delivery when appropriate.
Preserve accepted state and route both byte fingerprints to cryptographic-integrity review.
